records.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Repair production PIXEL GAME TOKEN for 글로르핀델(도보) (glorfindel_foot). Image 1 is the ORIGINAL identity, equipment, pose, action and silhouette. Image 2 controls crisp pixel clusters, short color ramps, stepped dark outline, elevated front camera and lowered head only; DO NOT copy its costume/weapon. Image 3 if supplied is species ANATOMY proportions only, never transfer its pose or gray clothes. Start from original action and EXACT weapon/shield/banner/staff/bow placement and relative size; preserve original body lean and hand grips, no generic pose substitution, no missing or invented gear. Repair stated defect: 기존 숙인 머리·곡검·무게감보다 정면 얼굴 노출이 강해짐.. HUMAN/ELF: exactly FIVE anatomical head lengths, crown-to-chin excluding hair/helmet crest. Head natural, proportionate shoulder width, neck, arms, hands, pelvis and leg bones. Never four-head chibi or six-plus-head fashion anatomy. Camera high-angle FRONT looking DOWN45degrees over the WHOLE body, crown and shoulder tops visible; still front-facing, not top-down, side or rear. Chin and gaze point gently downward like original; face mostly hidden under hair/hood/helmet, no looking at viewer. Preserve original unique silhouette, material colors and heraldry. Crisp deliberate PIXEL artwork, not smooth painting/3D. Entire character/mount/all appendages and equipment inside INNER80percent of transparent canvas, broad empty margins, body centered excluding weapons. No floor, base, scenery, cast shadow, haze, glow, text or UI. Output ONLY this one original subject.
records.notes: 기존 금발·청금 갑주·흰 망토와 아래로 든 곡검을 유지하고, 머리를 숙여 얼굴 정면 노출을 줄임. 정수리와 어깨 윗면, 연결된 무릎·발목과 전진 동작을 비교함.
